quarterly_data.quarter: Qnity Electronics press release: Qnity Expands AI-Driven Advanced Packaging Capabilities (08-25-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Qnity introduced an integrated advanced-packaging materials platform combining metallization, bumping, dielectric and fine-line patterning for 2.5D, 3D and panel-level architectures, aimed at CoWoS, EMIB and HBM, which 'require precise plating height control and superior coplanarity'. It supports tin-silver (SnAg) micro-bumps, copper-to-copper direct and hybrid bonding and high-resolution dielectric and patterning processes, 'enabling 2 µm line/space metallization'. Named products: Intervia CB1000+ / CB3000 copper; Solderon TS8000 series SnAg micro-bump plating for HBM; Riston WBR5000 thick dry film photoresist for 2.5D packaging (200–320 μm film thickness, high-aspect-ratio copper pillar plating); Cyclotene dry film photo-imageable dielectric for fan-out panel-level packaging and advanced substrate, which fills through-glass vias (TGVs) for glass core substrates. Chuck Xu, President, Interconnect Solutions: AI, chiplets, HBM, 3D stacking and heterogeneous integration are creating demand for integrated solutions spanning advanced packaging and thermal management. No customers, volumes or availability dates are named.
quarterly_data.figure: 2 µm line/space metallization; Riston WBR5000 200–320 μm film thickness
